patch_draft.purpose: Prepare a design-only minimal patch draft without applying changes.
minimal_changes: Keep current behavior unchanged unless required by target phase.
Limit edits to the smallest necessary block.
Avoid unrelated refactor or formatting-only churn.
patch_draft.expected_effect: Patch plan becomes explicit and bounded for later execution phases.
patch_draft.potential_risk: Over-selection may dilute patch focus if unrelated files are included.
